t: This is St Philip and St James Church, a Catholic church in Herne Hill. It takes its name from two figures of the early Christian story. James the Elder was one of the Twelve Apostles, the first of them to be martyred, and he is the patron saint of Spain. Philip the Evangelist appears in the Acts of the Apostles. He was one of seven chosen to care for the poor in Jerusalem, and he baptised an Ethiopian man on the road to Gaza.
